# Photonic Interconnects

Lumilens photonic interconnects enable next-generation scale out and scale up AI architectures, allowing hyperscalers to massively expand GPU clusters and build denser compute nodes.

Lumilens provides next-gen photonic interconnects for massively scaling out – and scaling up – AI compute infrastructure.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6a5eb01e1a0580831020d31c_Photonic%20Interconnects%20(2).png)

## Full coverage for   scale-out + scale-up

Lumilens has a full portfolio of photonic interconnects including high-density pluggable, near-packaged, and co-packaged optics to support very large scale out and scale up architectures.

## Scale GPU-to-GPU direct connections by 100x

Unique scale up architecture breaks today’s GPU-to-GPU limitation to enable massive pod scaling, as well as disaggregation of very large clusters to better manage power limitations.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6a5eb20f26d9792e0665f140_Direct%20connections.png)

## Advanced silicon + packaging

Lumilens designs its own silicon to enable faster innovation cycles, supply chain continuity, and custom architectures for AI workloads. Using advanced packaging, it delivers a high-bandwidth silicon shoreline that scales AI connectivity efficiently.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6a74784e83f5adea648712bb_Internal%20development.png)

## Open ecosystem with top-tier technology partners

Faster innovation and production scale via an open ecosystem of top-tier partners for PAM4 DSPs with integrated drivers and TIAs, SiPho PICs with integrated lasers, fiber array units with low loss coupling per channel, and more.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/69360ad057680d61ea91d906_glass.png)
